card.name: Hair and teeth passages, next word
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs right before a body-part noun, mostly in text about hair care or the order of teeth erupting. It also fires on odd spots inside names.

modes.label: Hair care instructions
modes.description: A verb or linking word in a sentence about combing or styling hair, just before the next word.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Comb the hair to<< remove>> scaly debris and after suitably part

modes.label: Order of teeth
modes.description: "the" or a similar word in a list of which teeth come in next.
modes.example: starting with the incisors, followed by<< the>> canine teeth, and finally the premolars

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Partway through a proper name or surname in unrelated text.
modes.example: A recent meta-analysis by Roberts, Walton and Viecht<<b>>auer published in Psychological Bulletin

card.writes: It pushes down hair-related words as the next token, so the next word is unlikely to be hair.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in hair and teeth descriptions and steers the text away from saying hair next.
